codec_strategy._note: These are PIPELINE codecs (transcode targets), NOT model outputs. AI models output PNG (images) and MP4 (video). ProRes/H.264 are created in After Effects (per-beat, ProRes 4444 to preserve alpha) and Premiere Pro (master ProRes 422 HQ -> H.264 MP4 for VHS). See ProjectReference section 4b.

model_outputs.image_models: PNG (Flux.2 Dev — base + image edit); PNG with alpha (BiRefNet / SAM 3 / RMBG-2.0 matting, IC-Light V2 relight)

compositing_strategy.notes: IC-Light handles lighting harmonisation between generated layers. AE fallback if IC-Light insufficient.

generative_compositing_evaluated.reasoning: Time pressure (6-week deadline), risk of silent failures in compositing precision, author already commands AE/Premiere from filmmaking practice. Framed as deliberate engineering decision, not limitation. Door open for post-CAS exploration.

compositing_strategy.plate_generation_note: Plates generated via FLUX.1 Kontext Dev: reference image preserves composition, text prompt guides lighting/atmosphere changes per variant. Kontext available on ComfyUI Cloud as commercially-cleared model.

model_stack.constraint: Tier 1 — open-weights models only, no closed proprietary APIs
model_stack.base_generation_license: open weights, non-commercial (BFL) — academic use OK

model_stack.location_invariance_technique: depth + inpaint — protect locked regions with a mask, generate new content only inside the mask; the volcano/sky/valley cannot drift because they are never regenerated
model_stack.segmentation_matting: birefnet / sam3 / rmbg_2.0 (open) — plant layer extraction
model_stack.relighting: ic_light_v2 (CC BY-NC, open weights) — upgraded from V1
model_stack.ethics_note: Open-weights secures transparency, access, and reproducibility, but does NOT resolve training-data provenance/consent — that applies across Flux, Qwen, and Wan alike and must be named directly in the reflection paper, not glossed by 'open'.

orchestration.rationale: Composable skills (not monolithic runner) per Anthropic Skills methodology. Localised failures, compounding improvements, auditable for paper, removes node-graph debugging burden from author.
orchestration.source_methodology: Claude Skills paradigm — Anthropic engineering team, AI Code Summit 2025-2026

transition_and_timing_principle.rule: All transitions, fades, dissolves, and time-based opacity changes are handled in After Effects (per-beat) and Premiere Pro (final edit). Generation models produce full-visibility, full-opacity content.
fields_for_generation_stage_only: opacity (describes final layer blend, not a transition)
motion (describes content motion within shot — sent to Wan 2.2)
transition_and_timing_principle.important_note: Layer opacity values (e.g. 0.7 for smoke) describe the FINAL composited blend, not a fade. AE applies them as constant blend values. Layer motion (e.g. 'flower_bloom_then_fade') is generated content via Wan 2.2 — the word 'fade' here means the flower visually wilts within the shot, NOT a transition fade.

plate_philosophy.rule: Plates are single, clean, static environmental states. One lighting condition each. No smoke, no plant, no animals, no humans, no transitions, no time passing.
plate_philosophy.layers_separate: Moving or changing elements (smoke, plant, animals, humans, weather effects) are always separate layers, never baked into plates.
plate_philosophy.lighting_variants: When a location is used across multiple lighting states (day/dusk/night/dawn), generate a separate plate variant per state. Naming: {base}_{lighting}.
plate_philosophy.time_lapse_handling: Time-lapse and day-to-night transitions are handled editorially in AE/Premiere by transitioning between two plate variants. NOT generated as single plates.

project.reference_strategy: Base references generated fresh via Flux text-to-image (clean, no inherited artifacts). Four bases: A1_plate_pristine_day, A1_plate_terraced, A2_plate_pristine, A3_plate_chamber_thriving. All other plates derive from a locked base via Kontext.
project.location_invariance_rule: Within each act the location is invariant. Each act has exactly ONE fresh base plate (generated via Flux.2 text-to-image); all other states derive from it via Flux.2 image edit, so the valley (Act 1), valley (Act 2), and chamber-with-window-landscape (Act 3) stay identical across every beat. Only three fresh generations total. Each intermediate base (e.g. A1_plate_terraced) is locked before its own variants derive from it.
project.screenplay_source: AotE_V01_20260515 (12-beat screenplay; plant arc encoded into beats' plant_state + plant_production fields 2026-06-22)
project.dof_decision: DoF/ground-level fresh-plate experiment ABANDONED 2026-06-22: text-to-image gives the ground-level + DoF look but a NEW composition each time (cannot reproduce the locked plates' specific valley/volcano/slopes). No time to redo the plate set + all derived variants. DECISION: keep locked plates as-is; address foreground focus (if needed) in After Effects compositing once the plant layer exists and DoF can be judged in context. Do not re-attempt fresh-plate DoF.

beats.beat_name: Fade in on untouched Andean valley
beats.script_excerpt: We FADE IN FROM BLACK to reveal a vast landscape in high altitude... a thin plume of smoke rises from [Sabancaya] to a vast, blue sky. In the foreground of our view lies an untouched patch of grass-covered soil.
beats.script_summary: Fade in. The pristine Andean valley is revealed. Sabancaya stands on the horizon with a thin smoke plume. The foreground shows bare grass-covered soil where the plant will emerge.

layers.prompt: close-on patch of grass-flecked Andean soil, slightly disturbed earth, sharp focus, macro detail, mythic high-altitude texture
thin pale smoke plume rising slowly from volcanic summit, vertical, dissipating into blue sky

risk_flags: smoke motion must be subtle, not stylized

plant_production.note: Plant absent — empty valley. No plant layer.

beats.script_excerpt: There, our unlikely hero emerges: a POTATO PLANT SPROUT courageously pushes through the ground. Within seconds -- and by defying all laws of time -- the seedling grows into a stubborn, leaf-bushy plant.
beats.script_summary: Time-lapse: sprout pushes through soil, grows rapidly into a mature leaf-bushy plant. First appearance of the protagonist.

layers.prompt: time-lapse potato plant growth from soil to mature plant, single stem to leaf-bushy, locked center, sharp focus

plant_production.motion: sprout pushes through soil, then time-defying growth into a mature leaf-bushy plant
plant_production.generation: FLF2V: first frame = bare soil (no plant) → last frame = mature plant. RIFE extend. The hero growth shot.
plant_production.note: First appearance. Establishes the plant's identity that must hold for the rest of the film.

beats.script_excerpt: As the sun embraces it with warm light, the plant shows gratitude by developing a beautiful, violet flower... The bloom attracts a curious BEE, hovering into frame... drinking nectar from [the flowers].
beats.script_summary: Plant develops violet flowers under warm afternoon light. A bee enters, inspects, and feeds from the blooms. As the sun sets, the bee leaves, the flowers fade, leaves thicken, soil swells.

layers.prompt: mature potato plant developing violet flowers with yellow centers, gentle warm late-afternoon light, sharp focus, locked center
single honeybee hovering near violet potato flower, motion-blurred wings, sharp body, feeding pose

plant_production.motion: violet flowers open one by one, buds burst; bee enters, inspects, feeds; light shifts toward sunset; flowers then fade, leaves thicken, soil swells slightly
plant_production.generation: FLF2V plant bloom sequence; bee is a separate small animated layer composited over.
plant_production.note: Plant identity continues from B002 mature state. Bee is its own layer with its own flight motion.

beats.script_excerpt: Night falls and a bright moon rises, shedding cold light... we begin to hear SOUNDS of toe-nailed paws approaching. And after a moment, four sure-footed, slender legs enter the frame, slowly approaching the potato plant... A LLAMA!
beats.script_summary: Night, moonlit valley. Approaching toe-nailed paw sounds. Llama enters partially — slender legs, lowered head sniffing the plant.
